subject: Post-demo: procurement path & mutual action plan (PO vs card vs marketplace)
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Greene <sarah.greene@brightwellhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 15:10:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo recap & next steps

Hi Sarah — great to meet today and thanks for walking us through Brightwell's priorities. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned:

- Procurement path: you mentioned Finance prefers a PO for platform purchases but Marketplace listing would be faster if legal approves vendor terms. Can you confirm the preferred path?
- Security asks: we agreed to share a short SOC2 summary and the security intake form Brightwell uses.
- Legal: you said legal may want a minor redline on our Data Processing Addendum (DPA).
- Timeline: you were hoping to have procurement decision by mid-June if the legal/security cycle is quick.

Action items I have for Redwood:
1) Share SOW outline + pricing term sheet (attached).
2) Send Redwood SOC2 summary and an intake copy of your procurement form (can you send if not already?)
3) Draft a suggested mutual action plan with owners and target dates.

Attachments: SOW_outline_v1.pdf, pricing-term-sheet.xlsx

Thanks — I can be flexible on times next week for a short procurement sync.

— Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Sarah Greene <sarah.greene@brightwellhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightwell Procurement <procurement@brightwellhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps

Thanks Logan — really helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- Procurement path: Finance + Procurement prefer to go PO route for anything > $50k/year. Marketplace is attractive (faster) but needs approval from Vendor Management first; that typically takes 2-3 weeks if we have all docs up front.
- Security: please send the SOC2 summary and complete our intake form. Our security team will run a short questionnaire (usually 5–7 business days).
- Legal: expect a small number of DPA clarifications. I can introduce you to our counsel (cc’ed procurement alias) — they’ll want the SOW + any data residency notes up front.
- Timeline: If we get the intake + SOW this week, Procurement aims to finish vendor review by 2027-05-23 and Finance can issue a PO by 2027-06-02, assuming no material redlines. If Marketplace is chosen we could be live earlier (pilot via marketplace) but Finance would still need billing approvals.

I’ve attached Brightwell_Procurement_Intake.pdf — please complete and return. I’ll loop in our legal contact once you send the SOW + DPA.

Best,
Sarah Greene
Director, IT Procurement | Brightwell Health
sarah.greene@brightwellhealth.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

- Logan (AE): finalize SOW outline, confirm pilot & billing preference (PO vs marketplace), follow up with Sarah for legal intro — target 2027-05-10.
- Karthik (Solutions): complete SOC2 summary and technical onboarding notes; prepare answers for expected security questionnaire — target 2027-05-12.
- Vanessa (CS/Onboarding): draft mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and acceptance criteria; coordinate with Pricing for final term sheet — target 2027-05-11.

Docs to attach when reaching back to Brightwell: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf, completed Brightwell intake form, SOW_outline_v1.pdf, pricing-term-sheet.xlsx. Keep marketplace option open as fallback — note that Marketplace requires vendor approval (2–3w).

I’ll prepare a MAP template and drop into the shared Drive folder. If legal asks for a DPA redline, Karthik can triage with LegalOps.

— Vanessa

Subject: Mutual action plan & tentative milestones (Brightwell Health / Redwood)

Sarah — thanks again. Per our thread and internal alignment, here’s a concise MAP we can update live (I’ll add it to the Drive link below):

1) 2027-05-10: Logan — send final SOW + completed Brightwell intake (ACTION: Logan) — attached SOW_outline_v1.pdf
2) 2027-05-12: Karthik — provide Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf and answers to intake questionnaire (ACTION: Karthik)
3) 2027-05-11: Vanessa — deliver MAP doc with milestones & acceptance criteria; include pilot success metrics (ACTION: Vanessa)
4) 2027-05-23: Procurement target complete — Vendor Management sign-off (DEPENDS: completed intake + SOC2 summary + legal DPA review)
5) 2027-06-02: Finance target — PO issued and billing set up (DEPENDS: Procurement sign-off)

Notes:
- If Brightwell prefers Marketplace & Vendor Management greenlights it, we can start a pilot earlier (estimated go-live in 7–10 business days after vendor approval).
- Redlines to our DPA: please send legal contact and any proposed redlines; Redwood LegalOps will respond within 3 business days for initial review.

Links & attachments: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf, SOW_outline_v1.pdf, pricing-term-sheet.xlsx. MAP draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-redwood-brightwell-demo-materials

Can we lock a 20-min procurement sync on Tue 2027-05-11 to run through the intake and ownership? I’m free 14:00–16:00 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.
